name: empty-states
title: Empty states
description: Four canonical empty states: first run (with checklist), no results (clear filters/search), no access (request access) and not found (optional action). FirstRunEmpty, NoResultsEmpty and NoAccessEmpty accept labels?: Partial<FirstRunEmptyLabels>, Partial<NoResultsEmptyLabels> and Partial<NoAccessEmptyLabels> respectively. Each type has its own keys below; explicit title, description, actionLabel and secondary props win. Defaults follow I18nProvider (en/es). NoResultsEmpty keeps the query in a mono span unless queryTitle replaces the heading. NotFoundEmpty and all imported fixtures stay English. See the Catalog labels live preview. NoAccessEmpty accepts showRequestAccess?: boolean (default true): false hides both the request button and its status announcement, so defaultRequested has no visible effect. action?: { label: string; href: string } renders one kit Link, styled like FirstRunEmpty’s secondary link; it is secondaryAction after the request button, or primaryAction when showRequestAccess is false. With showRequestAccess=false and no action, it renders no actions. Omitting onRequestAccess still shows the button by default. See the Spanish live preview for no actions, a link alone, and a link with the request button.
